nav.back_to_super_admin: Back to the super admin panel

index.title: Platform team
index.body: This panel is for the people who run the whole platform. Choose a page from the menu.
index.not_found_title: That page is not in this panel
index.not_found_body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. Choose a page from the menu.

home.title: Platform health
home.intro: A quick check that everything the platform runs on is working. Anything that could not be checked says so.
home.load_error_title: We couldn't check the platform just now
home.unknown_note: This could not be checked, so its state is not known.

overall.unknown: Some checks could not be read

value.browser_same: This browser is on the same version.
value.browser_other: This browser is on a different version. Reload the page.

failed_jobs.title: Failed background jobs
failed_jobs.intro: Work the platform tried to do in the background and could not finish, such as an email it could not send. Run one again, or discard it if it is no longer needed.
failed_jobs.load_error_title: We couldn't load the failed jobs just now
failed_jobs.empty_text: No background job has failed, or every one has been dealt with.
failed_jobs.retried: The job is back in the queue.
failed_jobs.action_failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.
failed_jobs.discard_message: The work it stood for will not be done, and this cannot be undone.

phone_app.title: Phone app
phone_app.intro: Who has the phone app, in every community on the platform. Members are named; their email addresses are not shown.
phone_app.not_downloads: These are members signed in on the app, not downloads from the app stores.
phone_app.load_error_title: We couldn't load the phone app figures just now

senior_accounts.title: Senior accounts
senior_accounts.intro: Every account that can manage more than one community, when it last signed in, and whether two-step sign-in is on.
senior_accounts.read_only_note: This page only shows these accounts. Nothing here gives or takes away access.
senior_accounts.load_error_title: We couldn't load the senior accounts just now
senior_accounts.without_two_step: Two-step sign-in is off for {{count}} of these {{total}} accounts.
senior_accounts.all_have_two_step: Two-step sign-in is on for all {{total}} of these accounts.
senior_accounts.truncated: Only the first {{count}} accounts are shown.

level.platform_flag_only: Platform-wide access, but not on the platform team

level_note.platform_team: Can do everything, in every community, including this panel.
level_note.global_super_admin: Can administer every community, but cannot open this panel.
level_note.tenant_super_admin: Can administer their own community and every community below it.
level_note.platform_flag_only: These accounts carry the platform team mark, or the old "god" role, without being super admins. They cannot open this panel, but other parts of the platform still treat them as platform-wide. Each one should be put right.

senior_accounts.incomplete: Platform-wide elsewhere, not on the platform team

accounts.title: Find an account
accounts.intro: Look an account up by its email address, in every community. If you need to, sign it out everywhere.
accounts.recorded_note: Each search is recorded: who searched and which accounts were found, never the address. Nothing here changes a password, a role or anyone's access.
accounts.email_hint: Type the whole address. Part of an address finds nothing.
accounts.email_invalid: Type one whole email address, such as name@example.org.
accounts.too_many: That is a lot of searches. Wait a minute, then try again.
accounts.none_note: Every community was checked. Erased accounts are never found.
accounts.truncated: Only the first {{count}} accounts are shown.

level.platform_flag_only: Platform-wide access, not on the platform team

accounts.no_community_note: This account is in no community, so it has no sign-ins to end.
accounts.done_toast_unnamed: The account was signed out everywhere.

confirm.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
confirm.text: They will be signed out on every phone and computer and must sign in again. Their password is not changed. Notifications to their phone stop until they sign in again.
confirm.own_account: This is your own account. You will have to sign in again too.
confirm.reason_hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. It is kept with the record of this, in the account's own community.
confirm.step_note: You may be asked for your sign-in code first.
confirm.step_cancelled: You did not confirm it was you, so nobody was signed out.
confirm.failed: That didn't work. Nobody was signed out.
confirm.gone: This account can no longer be signed out from here. Search again.

sign_outs.title: Accounts signed out by the platform team
sign_outs.note: Done from the Find an account page. The reason given each time is kept in that community's own record and is not shown here.
sign_outs.empty: The platform team signed nobody out in the last {{days}} days.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Who holds senior access, who was given it or lost it, who signed in as another member, and where sign-ins are failing. Across every community.
security.privacy_note: People and communities are shown by name. Email addresses and internet addresses are never shown here.
security.load_error_title: We couldn't load the security page just now
security.unavailable: This could not be checked just now.

two_step.title: Two-step sign-in on senior accounts
two_step.off: Two-step sign-in is off for {{count}} of {{total}} senior accounts.
two_step.all_on: Two-step sign-in is on for all {{total}} senior accounts.

failed.title: Failed sign-ins
failed.note: Every failed sign-in is counted as it happens, by community and by the hour. The count keeps only a number: nothing about the person or where they signed in from. Figures are counted in whole hours, so each one can include up to an hour more.
failed.nothing_counted: Nothing has been counted yet. Failed sign-ins are counted from the day this count was switched on.
failed.empty: No failed sign-ins in the last 24 hours.
failed.recent_note: Which internet addresses are being tried right now. The platform keeps these details for only about 20 minutes, and forgets an address's failures when it next signs in successfully. Sign-ins through the accessible site all arrive from one address.
failed.addresses_15m: Different internet addresses in the last 15 minutes
failed.most_from_one_15m: Most from one address in the last 15 minutes

access.title: Senior access given and removed
access.note: Not shown here: changes to platform team membership, which is set in the database and not recorded; and tenant super admin access taken from everyone at once when a community stops being a hub.
access.empty: No senior access was given or removed in the last {{days}} days.

impersonation.title: Signed in as another member
impersonation.note: An admin can sign in as a member to help them. Every time that happened is listed here.
impersonation.empty: Nobody signed in as another member in the last {{days}} days.

glance.title: Communities at a glance
glance.intro: Every community on the platform, and which features each one has switched on.
glance.read_only_note: This page only shows the switches. To change one, open that community's own admin panel.
glance.load_error_title: We couldn't load the communities just now
glance.held: On here, but switched off for the whole platform
glance.held_note: A feature marked with a padlock is switched on in that community, but a platform-wide switch is holding it off. It will not work there until the platform switch is turned on.
glance.modules_note: The parts every community starts with. A community can still switch one off.

notices.title: Notices
notices.intro: Write a short notice once and every community's admins see it at the top of the admin panel. Members and brokers never see it.
notices.load_error_title: We couldn't load the notices just now
notices.empty_text: Nothing has been written, so admins see nothing extra.
notices.end_message: Every admin stops seeing it straight away. It cannot be started again; write a new one instead.
notices.save_failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.

form.language_note: The notice is shown as you write it. It is not translated.
form.message_required: Write the notice, in 280 characters or fewer.
form.link_hint: A full address that starts with https://
form.link_label_required: Add the words to show for the link, or leave the link empty.
form.until_before_from: The end must be later than the start.
form.can_close_hint: If this is off, the notice stays until it finishes or you end it.
form.reshow_note: If you change the words, the kind or the link, people who closed this notice will see it again.

usage.title: Usage per community
usage.intro: How much each community used in one month: emails, AI chat, and the space its groups’ files take.
usage.load_error_title: We couldn’t load the usage figures just now

unavailable.emails: Email figures could not be read just now. They are not zero.
unavailable.ai_chat: AI chat figures could not be read just now. They are not zero.
unavailable.group_files: Group file sizes could not be read just now. They are not zero.

usage.platform_mail_note: Emails the platform sent that belong to no one community.
usage.sent_note: “Sent” means the email was handed to the mail service. It does not prove the email arrived.
usage.ai_note: AI cost is what was recorded for each request, in US dollars.
usage.files_note: Group files is the space they take today, not what was added in this month.
usage.not_recorded_intro: The platform does not count these anywhere yet, so this page cannot show them.

not_recorded.other_storage: Other stored files, such as photos in posts, profile pictures and documents

community_health.title: Community health
community_health.intro: How busy each community is: its members, its exchanges and its new listings.
community_health.same_as_dashboard: Everything is counted the same way as on each community's own admin dashboard.
community_health.counts_only: Counts only. No member is named on this page.
community_health.load_error_title: We couldn't load community health just now
community_health.quiet_rule: A community is called quiet when it is switched on and either no member has been active in the last {{days}} days, or there has been no exchange this month and none last month.
community_health.unavailable_note: Some figures could not be read just now. They say "Not available". They are not zero.

community_setup.title: Community setup
community_setup.intro: How far each community has got with its first setup steps. Newest communities first.
community_setup.yes_no_only: Done or not done only. No person is named on this page.
community_setup.load_error_title: We couldn't load community setup just now
community_setup.terms_note: Terms are added automatically when a community is created, so a tick for terms means less than the others.
community_setup.not_recorded: Whether a community's email sending has been tested is not recorded anywhere, so this page does not show it.
community_setup.unavailable_note: Some steps could not be read just now. They say "Not available". That does not mean they are not done.

unfinished_features.title: Unfinished features
unfinished_features.intro: Features that are still being tested, and features that stay off unless a community switches them on. For each one, the communities that have it on.
unfinished_features.read_only: This page only shows. A feature is switched on or off in that community's own admin panel.
unfinished_features.load_error_title: We couldn't load the unfinished features just now
unfinished_features.summary_on_somewhere: On in at least one community: {{count}}
unfinished_features.not_on_admin_page: Not on the admin Features page

note.not_for_use: Not for use. It must not be switched on for any community.

data_requests.title: Data requests
data_requests.intro: Requests members have made about their own data, in every community: how many are waiting, and for how long.
data_requests.where_answered: Each community answers its own requests in its own admin panel. Nothing can be changed from this page.
data_requests.counts_only: Counts only. No member and no request is named on this page.
data_requests.load_error_title: We couldn't load data requests just now
data_requests.none_overdue: No community has an overdue request.
data_requests.overdue_unknown: We can't tell just now whether any request is overdue.
data_requests.overdue_rule: A request is overdue when it has been open for more than {{days}} days. The clock starts when the request was made. Open means waiting, or being worked on.
data_requests.nearly_due_rule: Nearly due means open for {{from}} to {{to}} days.
data_requests.unavailable_note: Some figures could not be read just now. They say "Not available". They are not zero.

legal_documents.title: Legal documents
legal_documents.intro: The terms, privacy notice and other legal documents of every community: which are published, and how many members have not accepted the current version.
legal_documents.where_changed: Each community writes and publishes its own documents in its own admin panel. Nothing can be changed from this page.
legal_documents.counts_only: Counts only. No member is named on this page.
legal_documents.load_error_title: We couldn't load legal documents just now
legal_documents.no_privacy_count: Communities without a published privacy notice: {{count}}
legal_documents.all_have_privacy: Every community has a published privacy notice.
legal_documents.privacy_unknown: We can't tell just now which communities have a privacy notice.
legal_documents.who_is_asked: Members asked means active members who are not administrators. Administrators are never asked to accept.
legal_documents.terms_seeded: Terms are added automatically when a community is created.
legal_documents.no_acceptance_needed: Members are not asked to accept this one.
legal_documents.members_not_accepted: Not accepted yet: {{count}} of {{asked}} members asked
legal_documents.unavailable_note: Some figures could not be read just now. They say "Not available". They are not zero.

access_review.title: Access review
access_review.intro: Go through every senior account and say whether it should keep its access. A review is due at least every 90 days.
access_review.load_error_title: We couldn't load the access review just now
access_review.never: No review has been recorded yet.
access_review.last_review_erased: Last review: {{date}}, recorded by an erased account.
access_review.not_due: The next review is due by {{date}}.
access_review.review_intro: Choose Keep or Should be removed for every account. Nothing is chosen for you.
access_review.nothing_changes: Recording a review changes nobody's access. To remove access, do it in the super admin panel (for super admins) or in the database (for the platform team). The next review shows anyone marked for removal who is still here.
access_review.note_hint: Up to {{max}} characters. Only the platform team sees it.
access_review.error_step_cancelled: The review was not recorded: the sign-in code was not entered. Your choices are still here.
access_review.error_list_changed: The list changed while you were reviewing. Load it again and check the new list.
access_review.error_failed: The review could not be recorded. Nothing was saved. Try again.
access_review.no_accounts: There are no senior accounts to review.
access_review.open_title: Marked for removal last time and still here
access_review.open_intro: These accounts were marked "Should be removed" in the last review, and they still have their access.

push_notifications.title: Push notifications
push_notifications.intro: How many notifications were sent to members’ phones and browsers, by day and by community. “Accepted by the push service” means the service took the notification, not that a phone showed it. Some kinds of notification are sent without being recorded here (event reminders, emergency alerts and some others), so the real numbers are at least these.
push_notifications.timezone_note: Days run in the server’s time (UTC).
push_notifications.load_error_title: The push notification figures could not be loaded
push_notifications.not_available: Not available: the record of push notifications could not be read. This does not mean none were sent.
push_notifications.by_community_note: Totals for the whole period. “Nobody to send to” is shown per day only.
push_notifications.no_community_note: Notifications recorded without a community. They are included in the daily figures.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.intro: The last deployments and rollbacks this server recorded, newest first. Times are shown in your own time zone.
deployments.watch_note: The 30-minute watch for errors that follows each deployment is not recorded here.
deployments.load_error_title: The deployment record could not be loaded
deployments.no_record_title: This server keeps no record of deployments
deployments.no_record_text: Only the live server keeps one, so on a developer's computer this is expected.
deployments.skipped: Lines in the record that could not be read and were skipped: {{count}}

connections.title: Keys and connections
connections.intro: Which outside services this server has a key for. "Set up" means a key is in place. It does not prove the service is working.
connections.never_shown: This page never shows a key or any part of one.
connections.no_expiry: Expiry dates for keys are not recorded anywhere, so none are shown.
connections.load_error_title: Keys and connections could not be loaded

detail.stripe_webhook: Key that checks payment messages really come from Stripe
detail.cloudflare_origin: Key that proves visits came through Cloudflare
detail.slack_slo_alerts: Alerts when the platform is slow or failing
detail.slack_email_alerts: Alerts when email sending has problems
detail.file_storage: Always set up: uploaded files are kept on this server or in the storage it is told to use.

elsewhere.title: Where three other controls are
elsewhere.consent_types: Consent types are in the admin panel
elsewhere.identity_fee: The identity check fee is in the admin panel, under Modules
elsewhere.secrets_replaced: The old list of server keys has been replaced by this page.
